title: Nations & Economies - Rich Coupled Data Layer
purpose: Integrate economic, trade, industrial and strategic data into nation profiles. Enable analysis of dependencies, vulnerabilities, and geopolitical leverage.
methodology: Each nation is not isolated but defined through its relationships: who it trades with, what it depends on, who depends on it, what it makes, where its vulnerabilities lie, and what institutions/actors have influence.
